description: Phase 22F: hard negative controls for confidence calibration. Each query deliberately shares vocabulary/topical territory with real incidents in the corpus (verified via live dense search, see 'nearest_real_incident' below) without describing the same underlying problem. Companion dataset to tests/eval/gold_queries.json's 4 easy negatives -- these are NOT a replacement, both are evaluated together in Phase 22F. Probed against the live corpus with scripts/phase22f_probe_hard_negatives.py; raw probe output in scripts/phase22f_hard_negative_probe_results.json.

queries.query: Stripe webhook signature verification fails intermittently for subscription renewal events
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:istio/istio#60774 "webhook caBundle not updated after migrating serving cert to istio-csr" (top1=0.4224)
queries.why_not_represented: Corpus has zero payment-processing or Stripe-related content at all; the match is purely on the shared word 'webhook' plus generic signature/certificate-verification vocabulary from an unrelated Istio cert-rotation bug.
queries.adjacent_topic_family: Istio webhook/certificate infrastructure (unrelated domain, coincidental lexical overlap only)

queries.query: OAuth2 refresh token silently expires causing repeated re-login prompts in the web console
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:getsentry/sentry#120727 "Creating an org auth token through UI hangs, creates duplicates" (top1=0.4487)
queries.why_not_represented: The nearest match is about a UI bug creating duplicate auth tokens, not a refresh-token expiry/re-login-loop problem -- different failure mode entirely, related only by the general 'auth token' vocabulary.

queries.query: PagerDuty alert routing sends duplicate incident pages to the same on-call engineer
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:prometheus/prometheus#17924 "Wrong filtering on alerts/rules page" (top1=0.4540)
queries.why_not_represented: Nearest match is a Prometheus UI filtering bug on an alerts listing page, not an alert-routing/deduplication/paging problem, and doesn't involve PagerDuty at all.
queries.adjacent_topic_family: Prometheus's own alerts-page UI (not alert delivery/routing)

queries.query: Container restarts constantly due to an OOMKilled event triggered by a memory leak in a sidecar proxy
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:kubernetes/kubernetes#138760 "In-place container memory resize does not work when pod is in status OOMKilled" (top1=0.5264)
queries.why_not_represented: Nearest match is about the in-place-resize feature not working once a pod is already OOMKilled -- a resize-API bug, not a sidecar memory leak causing repeated OOM kills.

queries.query: DNS resolution intermittently fails for pods running in a different availability zone
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:kubernetes/kubernetes#129617 "DNS latency when a CoreDNS pod is deleted" (top1=0.6886)
queries.why_not_represented: Nearest match is CoreDNS latency triggered specifically by pod deletion, not a cross-availability-zone resolution failure -- same DNS subsystem, different trigger and symptom.

queries.query: Slack integration fails to post messages after workspace token rotation
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:getsentry/sentry#122790 "Alert Slack notifications sent out of order (Resolved arrives before Critical/Warning)" (top1=0.4797)
queries.why_not_represented: Nearest match is a message-ordering bug in an already-working Slack integration, not a token-rotation-breaks-delivery failure.

queries.query: PostgreSQL replication lag spikes during nightly vacuum causing read replica staleness
queries.nearest_real_incident: jira:CASSANDRA-14728 "Transient Replication 4.x: follow-up work" (top1=0.4975)
queries.why_not_represented: Corpus has no PostgreSQL content and no VACUUM-related issue; match is purely on the generic word 'replication' against unrelated Cassandra/Kafka replication-internals tickets.
queries.adjacent_topic_family: Cassandra/Kafka replication internals (different database systems entirely)

queries.query: GraphQL query depth limit rejects legitimate nested queries from the mobile client
queries.nearest_real_incident: jira:CASSANDRA-14620 "Make it possible for full query log to only record queries for a given subrange" (top1=0.4328)
queries.why_not_represented: Corpus has no GraphQL content at all; match is purely on the generic word 'query' against a CQL query-logging feature request.
queries.adjacent_topic_family: Cassandra CQL query tooling (unrelated to GraphQL)

queries.query: Helm chart values override silently ignored when using multiple values files with the same key
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:helm/helm#31291 "Values file set to '{}' cannot overwrite" (top1=0.7563)
queries.why_not_represented: Same general Helm values-precedence subsystem, but the real issue is about an empty-object value blocking an override; this query is about multiple values files silently losing a shared key -- a different specific merge bug. BORDERLINE: flagged in analysis as the closest call in this dataset -- a domain expert could reasonably argue these are close enough to be 'the same class of bug.'
queries.adjacent_topic_family: Helm values-file merge/precedence (very close domain -- borderline case, see analysis)

queries.query: Kubernetes cluster upgrade from 1.28 to 1.29 breaks a custom admission webhook due to API version deprecation
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:kubernetes/kubernetes#137356 "kube-apiserver upgrade from v1.32 to v1.33 can deadlock due to admission webhooks and new, default-enabled APIs like ServiceCIDR" (top1=0.7462)
queries.why_not_represented: Different specific versions and different failure mechanism (apiserver deadlock vs. a custom webhook breaking from API deprecation), but same general 'version upgrade breaks admission webhooks' theme. BORDERLINE: flagged in analysis alongside hard-neg-config-01 as an ambiguous case.
queries.adjacent_topic_family: Kubernetes admission-webhook/upgrade compatibility (very close domain -- borderline case, see analysis)

queries.query: Recurring invoice generation skips a billing cycle for annual subscription plans
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:getsentry/sentry#122811 "Trigger billing/usage alerts if I am forecast to go over my quota for the month" (top1=0.3602)
queries.why_not_represented: Nearest match is a usage-quota alerting feature request, not an invoice-generation/billing-cycle-skip bug.

queries.query: Multi-factor authentication SMS codes arrive after the expiration window in the login flow
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:getsentry/sentry#122437 "SAML2 Login Dark mode" (top1=0.3124)
queries.why_not_represented: Nearest match is a cosmetic dark-mode styling bug on a SAML login page -- unrelated to SMS/MFA delivery timing.
queries.adjacent_topic_family: Sentry's own SSO/login UI (weak overlap -- this one behaved more like an easy negative empirically, see analysis)

queries.query: Grafana dashboard panels show flat zero metrics after a Prometheus remote_write endpoint migration
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:prometheus/prometheus#11784 "Remote write stop sending samples" (top1=0.6383)
queries.why_not_represented: Same remote_write subsystem, but the real issue is samples not being sent at all (a sender-side bug); this query is about dashboards reading zero AFTER an endpoint migration -- a different specific trigger and observation point (Grafana vs. Prometheus internals).

queries.query: HorizontalPodAutoscaler fails to scale down replicas even after CPU utilization drops below target
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:kubernetes/kubernetes#140858 "A StatefulSet cannot be correctly scaled down after a failed scale-up" (top1=0.6147)
queries.why_not_represented: Different controller (StatefulSet manual/declarative scaling vs. HPA's CPU-target-driven autoscaling) and different trigger (a prior failed scale-up vs. CPU dropping below target).

queries.query: Istio Envoy sidecar injection fails silently for pods in a namespace with a custom PodSecurityPolicy
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:istio/istio#60667 "Clarification on connection_security_policy=unknown" (top1=0.6625)
queries.why_not_represented: Real issue is a documentation/clarification question about a security-policy config value; this query is about sidecar injection silently failing under a PodSecurityPolicy -- different mechanism, different symptom.

queries.query: LangChain agent tool-calling loop times out when chained with a custom retriever that wraps an external vector store
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:langchain-ai/langchain#37673 "VectorStore.add_texts exhausts generator inputs before creating documents" (top1=0.5502)
queries.why_not_represented: Real issue is an ingestion-time generator-exhaustion bug in add_texts; this query is about an agent tool-calling timeout during retrieval -- different component (ingestion vs. agent loop) and different failure mode.

queries.query: Redis cluster failover takes over 30 seconds causing client connection timeouts during primary election
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:redis/redis#15181 "[BUG] Cluster bus outbound reconnect storm on connection failure (no backoff)" (top1=0.6822)
queries.why_not_represented: Real issue is a reconnect-storm caused by missing backoff on the cluster bus; this query is about failover/primary-election latency -- related cluster-reliability territory, different specific mechanism.

queries.query: TypeScript compiler emits incorrect type narrowing for a discriminated union inside a generic function
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:microsoft/TypeScript#18717 "Union type inference failure in generic function" (top1=0.7795)
queries.why_not_represented: Both concern union-type handling inside generic functions, but the real issue is inference failure, not narrowing of a discriminated union specifically. BORDERLINE: the highest-scoring item in this dataset and the closest call -- flagged explicitly in analysis.
queries.adjacent_topic_family: TypeScript generic/union type-checking (very close domain -- borderline case, see analysis)

queries.query: Terraform state lock is not released after a CI pipeline is cancelled mid-apply
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:hashicorp/terraform#23655 "Terraform console creates a lock that does not go away before it's closed" (top1=0.7218)
queries.why_not_represented: Real issue is `terraform console` leaving a stale lock; this query is about a CI-pipeline cancellation mid-`apply` leaving a stale lock -- different command/trigger, same general state-locking subsystem.

queries.query: Airflow DAG scheduler silently skips a task instance after a timezone configuration change
queries.nearest_real_incident: github:apache/airflow#62050 "Scheduler bulk-fails all scheduled tasks when serialized DAG is transiently missing" (top1=0.5869)
queries.why_not_represented: Real issue is a bulk-fail triggered by a transiently-missing serialized DAG; this query is about a single task silently skipped after a timezone config change -- different trigger and different failure shape (silent skip vs. bulk fail).
